title: Test speakers with audio tones
summary: Use the speaker-test command to play pink noise, sine waves, or WAV files through your speakers. This helps verify that audio output is working correctly and identify which channels are active.

steps.explain: Run speaker-test to play pink noise through the default audio device. Press Ctrl+C to stop the test.
steps.expect: You should hear pink noise coming from the speakers. The terminal will display channel information.

steps.explain: To test with a sine wave at a specific frequency (e.g., 440 Hz), use the sine test mode. Replace <FREQUENCY> with the desired Hz value.

placeholders.name: FREQUENCY
placeholders.description: Frequency of the sine wave in Hz

steps.expect: You should hear a pure tone at the specified frequency.

steps.explain: To test multichannel setups (e.g., 5.1 surround), specify the number of channels. Replace <CHANNELS> with a number from 1 to 8.

placeholders.name: CHANNELS
placeholders.description: Number of audio channels to test (1-8)

steps.expect: You should hear test sounds cycling through the specified number of channels.
